summary: NextNRG, Inc. filed a Form 8-K reporting a one-for-ten reverse split of its common stock, effected via a Certificate of Amendment to its Amended and Restated Certificate of Incorporation filed September 10, 2026, effective 12:01 a.m. on September 14, 2026. Outstanding shares fall from roughly 168.4 million to 16.8 million, with trading continuing on Nasdaq under NXXT on a post-split basis and a new CUSIP 652941204. Proportional adjustments were made to options and warrants; fractional entitlements round up. No special-situation transaction, board recommendation, or advisor is involved.
